label: Public debt / GDP
note: Statutory anchor is 55% by 2028; the IMF projects 71.6% for 2026. High debt raises the yield the government must offer — good for new buyers, a warning on sustainability.

label: Reserves (import cover)
note: USD 13.35bn. Comfortably above the 4-month statutory floor and the EAC's 4.5-month criterion — the buffer that backs shilling stability.

label: GDP growth
note: Actual 2025 outturn, retrieved live from the World Bank API. Projections for 2025–27 average 4.9%, and CBK's own 2026 forecast is 5.3%. Growth is what services the debt.

label: Real yield (10y net, after inflation)
source: Derived: net yield less KNBS CPI
note: What a 10-year bond earns above inflation after withholding tax. This — not the headline coupon — is the number that grows purchasing power.
